text:
Maya: Heads-up 10am: we need final microcopy for the benchmark launch posts + a tiny routing table for inbound leads. Focus: fastpath vs cheappath positioning (latency-first vs cost-first). Please drop: 1) a single-line hero caption, 2) preferred visual (stacked-bar / sparkline / bar+line combo), 3) routing tag and recommended lead priority (hot/warm). Try to keep each caption ~8-12 words.

Owen: Hero caption: 'Fast path for latency-sensitive apps, cheap path for background jobs.' Visual: bar+line combo (cost bars, latency line). Routing: #acct-exec, priority: hot. :dart:

Samir: Hero caption: 'Cut token spend without slowing down user journeys.' Visual: stacked-bar (quantization vs batching savings). Routing: #demand-gen, priority: warm. Add small CTA: 'See the breakdown.'

Lina: Hero caption: 'Predictable p99 under 250ms for interactive features.' Visual: tailband heatmap (banded colors). Routing: #product, priority: hot. Note: call out test corpus in paren.

Maya: Love these. Also need webinar blurb: single-line hook + one-sentence follow.

Owen: Webinar hook: 'How we built a two-path serving strategy that saves money and preserves SLAs.' Follow: 'Live demo of our batching, caching, and routing knobs, plus Q&A.'

Samir: Quick ask 1: can we create an inbound CSV so Ops can auto-tag and set lead score? I'll sketch heuristics (tokens/day, demo requested, company size).

Maya: Please. Also propose A/B subject lines for the invite.

Lina: Subject A: 'See inference savings in action' Subject B: 'Keep user latency, slash your GPU bill' 1 route B to enterprise SDRs.

Samir: CSV sample:```visual_type,caption,routing_tag,priority,lead_score_rule
bar_line,"Fast path for latency-sensitive apps, cheap path for background jobs.",acct-exec,hot,"if company_size>500 -> 90"
stacked_bar,"Cut token spend without slowing down user journeys.",demand-gen,warm,"if tokens_per_day>1e6 -> 60"
heatmap,"Predictable p99 under 250ms for interactive features.",product,hot,"if demo_requested==true -> 80"```

Maya: OpsBot, can you confirm this mapping works with the webhook?

OpsBot: mapping-acknowledged: 1789994500 1 webhook schema expects routing_tag without '#', and lead_score_rule should be a string. Example endpoint: https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead-route :gear:

Owen: Also suggest adding tiny testimonial line under the chart: 'Benchmark on web-chat dataset v1.2' and link to eval repo.

Jules: For social microcopy variants: short (for X): '2x latency for common prompts, 40% token savings.' medium (for LinkedIn): 'Tradeoff controls let you keep latency where it matters and reduce token spend elsewhere.' Suggested visual: small gif of chart cycling between fastpath and cheappath.

Maya: Great. One more: how do we surface the uncertainty? Nora had a good footnote idea but let's add an explicit sentence: 'Results based on our internal corpus; your mileage may vary.' Put it in the landing page legal small text.

Samir: For landing page CTA A/B: A = 'Register to see the playbook' (nurture), B = 'Request enterprise demo' (SDR). We'll route based on lead_score_rule.

Lina: I'll mock the tailband heatmap today and drop PNGs. Owen and Jules, can you export the bar+line and stacked bars?

OpsBot: assets-uploaded: 1789994620 1 /assets/bench/1789/ (pngs + gif)

Maya: OK team 1 I'll assemble the launch doc and push to the content repository. Standby for the handoff ticket to GrowthOps. Thanks!
